scope_notes.summary: Five dated NOAA/DUACS comparisons are retained. For four predeclared 2025 dates, NOAA connects only in April; its other nominal traces stop at missing velocities. DUACS supplies four contours; April method difference is 19.5 km. The September 2026 comparison and failed neighbors remain available. Shared inputs, gates and sparse date coverage prevent treating these as independent confirmation, annual extrema, widths or ranked whole-current lengths.
